name: pages-storage
description: Token relay for Sign in with GitHub on static sites (Cloudflare Worker)

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: The **Client ID** from your GitHub App's settings page. It starts with `Iv`. [Make the app first](https://github.com/barton-muller/pages-storage#1-make-a-github-app).

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A **client secret** generated on the same GitHub App page. It is shown once. Never put it in a repo or a website.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: The sites that may use this relay, comma-separated, each as scheme and host with no path and no trailing slash. Example: `https://you.github.io,https://example.com`.
